name: Amapá Minerals Holdings Inc.
summary: Amapá Minerals Holdings Inc. focuses on the exploration, development, and production of gold and other precious metal deposits in Brazil. The company owns and operates the Amapá Project consisting of 34 mineral tenure areas covering a total area of approximately 158,751.55 hectares located in the southeastern portion of Amapá State, northern Brazil. The company was formerly known as Amapá Precious Metals Inc. and changed its name to Amapá Minerals Holdings Inc. in June 2026. Amapá Minerals Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Pedra Branca do Amapari, Brazil.
